correctness.rationale: The all-k fixed-point formulas are proved by Hensel splitting at a unique 2-adic root of the characteristic polynomial, exact integer Smith bases for exponents 3, 6 and 12, and a mod-2 invertibility induction. Each possible least orbit length divides 3*2^k and its cycle count follows by inclusion-exclusion and division by that length. Exact gcd-minor and exhaustive small-level computations were executed successfully from the embedded standalone verifier; the infinite step is deductive, not numerical.

Earlier k-order recurrence chapters remain a material priority risk because only abstract material was accessible.

Self-review correctness checks are not independent review.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural classification of the periodic points of a standard fifth-order recurrence, whose orbit census is explicitly listed as an independent OEIS object. It identifies every admissible length and its exact multiplicity for infinitely many moduli, with a nontrivial mixed 2-adic/third-root structural mechanism. It is not a routine single numerical instance, finite table extrapolation, or renaming of an existing formula.
